caption.text: Table 2 Hyperparameter analysis for the text optimizer. Each panel changes one scalar or scheduling factor from the default setting unless noted. Panel (a) fixes the split to 4:1:5 train/selection/test; the 1-example, 20%, 40%, and 80% rows use subsets of the training partition, and the 100% row reuses the completed 4:1:5 split-ratio run. Panel (b) sweeps the reflection mini-batchsize B_m; panel (c) sweeps the rollout batchsize B.
